title: Cross-review builder 3 CR–CV and BA with source-backed corrections
public_pr_body:
CR–CV and BA cross-review, retaining earlier CM–CQ corrections. The corrected guides prevent external AI sharing during a real-data rehearsal without written approval, limit Sage/QBO checks to implemented balance reads, and require the admin-code challenge in the smoke check.

CR/CS/CT/CU exact heads are unchanged. CV subsequently published as #315 at 727ff228b6bc8575bc4440f409fdd3c41fe4ce5e. Its reported tested candidate/CM inventories (5,622/415 and 5,357/373), successful log hashes and locked candidate install were checked against the exact source files; no new mistake found. These are reviewed local results, not builder-4 execution or DB/browser/release approval. Earlier branch-only notes are historical. BA #269's G01–G06 scope summary is corrected to G01–G08; its historical missing-140/141 condition is distinguished from deferred 142/143. The complete newer evidence register is preserved.

Findings/full heads: docs/signoff/BUILDER-3-CROSS-REVIEW.md. BA correction: tests/reviews/BA-269-SOURCE-CORRECTIONS.md. Prior queue handover: docs/signoff/HANDOVER-BUILDER-4-QUEUE-2.md. CW and CX use separate drafts.

Validation is scoped: earlier CM 9 tests/types/lint and CQ 3-test collection/lint retained; CS/CT anchors/count sets and exact source/tree comparisons. No new runtime claim or sign-off; actual DB/provider/browser/restore/manual proofs stay open. Draft only, no Ready/main merge/production SQL/deployment.

New BA #317 (9515eda33b50878a057a431b06498a5b1f15b204) is also reviewed. Four DAY-10–13 links incorrectly targeted the year-end ZIP description; the carried tests/BA-FIRST-DAY-EVIDENCE.md fixes them to CompanyDetailsCard in the same pinned source. All 41 item texts, missing-pack statuses and required proof remain unchanged.
